title: RWB-S5-E3019-APP: the take-on slice has no plan row for its cross-service reads, its outbox library, its requirement id or the duplicated R-DIS-06 criterion
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split_plan.json slices RWB-S5-E3019-APP and RWB-S5-E3019-CON; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 12, 13, 19, 29, 37, 41, 43 and 45; TSD S5 v2 T2, T3.1 to T3.3, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1; FSD S5 v3 A1.3, A2.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIS-01 and R-DIS-06; legacy RWB-E3-019 and RWB-E3-023
section: Metadata (Depends on (build), Contract dependencies, External dependencies); Sections 2, 3, 4, 7, 11, 12.2, 12.3 and 18
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S5-E3019-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-source-data data product and answers the rwb-case workflow boundary, so the consumed rows have no plan row. (2) Architecture v5 slide 19 gives the topic rwb.asset.events.v1 with AssetTakenOn and slide 43 row 22 gives it rwb-case and rwb-payment as consumers, yet the pattern set of this key omits DP-09, so the outbox and inbox library RWB-PLT-TE006-CON is absent from the H row. (3) The split plan carries no requirement id; REQ-S5-001 is read from the Business Requirements Program and TSD S5 T8. (4) The legacy masters carry the same R-DIS-06 criterion in RWB-E3-019 AC2 and RWB-E3-023 AC2, so two APP stories own the same words and the build must not run two clocks. (5) The Ownership Map table list carries listing and asset_sale for S5 and no asset row, although Architecture v5 slides 19 and 41 and TSD S5 T3.1 give the asset record to S5. (6) The legacy data table names v_ace_npa_asset, timer, decision_log_entry and rule_row, none of which this service may read or write. (7) The legacy step names RPS, the Field App, AMIS and SVAF as its sources, and the plan declares no external dependency because in the target those systems feed ACE.
evidence: split_plan.json slices RWB-S5-E3019-APP and -CON with three H rows and empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-05 and DP-09 rows; Architecture v5 slide 19 OUT and IN, slide 43 row 22, slide 13 row S5; ownership tables listing and asset_sale with no asset key; TSD S5 T3.1 asset and T8; Business Requirements Program v4 REQ-S5-001; legacy RWB-E3-019 AC2 and RWB-E3-023 AC2
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; record the rwb-source-data and rwb-case rows as C in fact with their placeholders, record RWB-PLT-TE006-CON as the wave 0 library the published event needs, add the asset row to the Ownership Map from Architecture v5 slides 19 and 41 and TSD S5 T3.1, adopt REQ-S5-001 for traceability, and state in both APP stories that only RWB-S5-E3023-APP runs the R-DIS-06 clocks

title: RWB-S5-E3019-CON: the consumed operation names, the case boundary name, the event consumer list and the error set have no published baseline
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split_plan.json slice RWB-S5-E3019-CON; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 11, 13, 19, 29, 37, 42, 43 and 45; TSD S5 v2 T3.1, T3.2, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1; FSD S5 v3 A2.1; legacy RWB-E3-019
section: Metadata (Depends on (build), Contract dependencies); Sections 3, 7, 11, 12.2, 12.5, 12.8 and 12.9
description: (1) The rwb-source-data data-product catalogue names DP06 Collateral and assets but publishes no operation name, so the consumed row carries a placeholder. (2) No source publishes a REST operation that moves a case state on behalf of a stage; the S5 row of the Architecture v5 connection matrix names Temporal to P7 and listening to S4 with no REST call to P3, so the case state and the stage outcome are declared as the child workflow's input, signals and result, and the element name carries a placeholder. (3) The consumer list of AssetTakenOn is read from Architecture v5 slide 43 row 22 only; no AsyncAPI catalogue exists at the time of writing. (4) The error set of the two reads is read from TSD S5 T-A.2 as status codes with no message id per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy and FSD set. (5) The Ownership Map carries no asset table row, so the contract's table list is read from Architecture v5 slides 19 and 41 and TSD S5 T3.1.
evidence: TSD S5 T-A.1 operations API-S5-001 and API-S5-002; T-A.2 error lists 400, 401, 403, 404, 422 and 503 without message ids; Architecture v5 slide 13 row S5 and the note that route services reach shared capabilities through Temporal and never REST; slide 43 row 22; ownership tables listing and asset_sale only; legacy RWB-E3-019 messages MSG-S5-001, MSG-S5-002, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003
proposed: Publish the baseline with the two placeholders, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, declare the case boundary as the child workflow's contract element, confirm the two names with their owners before the tag, and record the tag date in the contract README
